reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a new update that enhances the building experience in Provincia! Instead of hiding resource requirements behind a single cost chip, each build tile now displays a detailed Materials sheet. This allows you to see all the resources needed for your constructions at a glance, making it easier to manage your colony's needs. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
